text:
jamie: FYI customer corp 'AcmeMedia' can't start free trial. Flow requires card on file, Stripe returns `requires_action` and user sees 3DS loop. They pasted the error: `payment_intent.status = requires_action` and UI keeps asking to authenticate but never completes.

rachel: customer id and example session please? we'll need email + last4 + time to look up in admin.

jamie: sent PI and session: `pi_3KZ...789`, checkout_session `cs_test_a1b2`. Email: ops@acmemedia.com. Happening since 2026-03-14 15:22 UTC. They said mobile Safari.

henry-payments: I pulled the Stripe logs for pi_3KZ...789 — event shows `payment_intent.requires_action` then repeated `payment_intent.requires_payment_method` after failed challenge. Looks like SCA challenge never completed. Could be mobile webview or 3DS redirect blocked.

alex-eng: quick repro steps from our side: 1) create checkout session with `trial=true` and `payment_method_types=['card']` 2) submit card that triggers SCA (use test card `4000002500003155`) 3) complete challenge -> should go to `complete` state. On fail we see the loop. We have a small race in js checkout handler where we re-initiate confirmCardPayment on page reload. That can do multiple attempts and surface the same challenge repeatedly.

jamie: customer says they never see challenge UI on Safari — just spinner then error.

henry-payments: stripe-bot: show events for cs_test_a1b2

stripe-bot: POST /events  — payload: [ { "type": "checkout.session.completed", "data": { "object": { "id": "cs_test_a1b2", "payment_intent": "pi_3KZ...789" } } }, { "type": "payment_intent.payment_failed", "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_3KZ...789", "last_payment_error": { "message": "AuthenticationRequired", "code": "authentication_required" } } } } ]

katie-billing: Customer is blocked from claiming free credits because our onboarding requires a successful preauth. For some enterprise customers we can manually grant trial credits while payments are resolving. Do we want to do that?

rachel: yes please. We should also capture repro steps and file with payments/eng to prevent recurrence. I'll do manual grant if we get sign-off. Need: account id, amount, duration, and internal note.

jamie: Account: acct_5421. Grant 150 USD credits for 14 days. Note: onboarding blocked due to SCA loop on Safari mobile (pi_3KZ...789). Customer approved manual grant.

henry-payments: One mitigation: add a guard so the client doesn't re-call `confirmCardPayment` if `status` is `requires_action` and there is an outstanding challenge flow. Also add client-side fallback to open challenge in external browser on iOS (wkwebview blocks some 3DS flows). I'll open a small PR.

alex-eng: I'll include a short unit/integration test to simulate repeated confirm calls and assert we don't re-initiate while awaiting challenge. Also add telemetry to track `confirm_retries` for the next two weeks.

katie-billing: Manual grant done — txn admin note `MANUAL_TRIAL_GRANT by katie-billing for acct_5421: $150 for 14d, reason: 3DS loop`. Customer emailed with credits applied, asked to retry.

jamie: customer confirmed they can start trial now. They said Safari still errors on card add, so they've used a different browser. They've kept the session active and we see usage.

rachel: closing as "manual workaround applied + eng follow-up". Action items: 1) henry to PR guard 2) alex add test + telemetry 3) support to monitor similar tickets and escalate if repeat from same platform.

henry-payments: PR opened: `payments/checkout: prevent double-confirm on requires_action` — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/payments/pull/412

alex-eng: test and telemetry PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/891 — adds `confirm_retries` metric and integration test using Stripe test cards.

jamie: leaving thread for records. thanks team :thumbsup:
